title: Normalized completed pullback realization commutes with shifts
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite extension E of Q_l. Let f : X $\to$ Y be any morphism of schemes. Let SY be a coefficient derived-system calculus on Y [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], $\rho$ a K-injective-normalized Roos realization on X, and M a representative-normalized completed pullback realization [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models]. Let c be a coherent shift on the completed pullback cochain functor satisfying the two signed coordinate equations, and s a coherent shift on completed derived pullback satisfying descent from c [def-fd-integral-pullback-shift-coordinates]. Equip reduction, sequence pullback and total limit with the independently fixed shifts of [def-sf-integral-comparison-canonical-shifts]. Then M.realization.hom commutes with every integer shift as a natural transformation on the entire ambient derived category.

proof.text: Choose a flat-term K-flat representative P and a simultaneous quotient-system presentation (C,e,kappa). Compute each total-limit projection on an injective resolution and its shift; in degree j it is the same projection in degree j+m. Transpose the shift equation through the finite scalar adjunction. By the normalized counit projection formula its mate is the reduction evaluation comparison. The universal finite scalar counit identifies the finite representative shift with termwise reindexing. Present P[m] by C[m], conjugating e[m] by the reduction and localization shift isomorphisms. The finite presentation equation follows from that mate equation, and the horizontal equation is the shift of the old equation.

proof.text: Conjugate the old presentation map q[m] by the termwise pullback/scalar and restriction shifts to form q_m. Its unit tensor generator equation is exactly the old equation in degree j+m. The tensor and sheafification universal properties show that these generators determine the chain map. Thus the normalization applied to the shifted presentation gives q_m; all quotient transition maps still commute.

proof.text: Use the comparison formula rho.computes on a K-injective tower and its shifted tower. The canonical limit-to-Roos map has first coordinate equal to the limit tuple and second coordinate zero. The shift (y,x) ↦ ((−1)^m y,x) preserves precisely these two coordinates, so the bridge shift square commutes. Naturality along an injective replacement gives the same equation for the original tower.

proof.text: Apply the realization normalization to P and P[m]. Cancel its invertible presentation and Roos comparisons; the two signed coordinate equations and the retained descent equation identify the outer comparison with s. Naturality along the localized K-flat resolution gives the equation on every derived object.

lean.statement:
theorem integralComparisonPullbackRealization_commShift
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (SY : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E Y)
    (ρ : IntegralComparisonRoosModel l E X)
    (M : IntegralComparisonPullbackModel l E f SY ρ)
    (c : (integralOperationsPullbackComplexFunctor l E f).CommShift ℤ)
    (hc : IntegralCompletedComparison.ShiftCoordinates l E f c)
    (s : (integralDerivedPullback l E f).CommShift ℤ)
    (hs : IntegralCompletedComparison.ShiftDescent l E f c s) :
    letI := s
    letI := integralComparisonReductionShift l E Y SY
    letI := integralComparisonSequencePullbackShift l E f
    letI := integralComparisonLimitShift l E X
    NatTrans.CommShift M.realization.hom ℤ
